scripts.dev:server: node init && npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.dev:client: node init && npm --prefix client run dev
scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build:server: node init && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build:client: node init && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build: node init && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
